title: Quantifying and Avoiding Unfair Qualification Labour in Crowdsourcing
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on an ethical issue within crowdsourcing, specifically the fairness and ethics of 'Qualification Labour'. It argues that requiring workers to complete a substantial amount of poorly paid work to qualify for better-paying tasks is an unfair labor practice. The research quantifies this issue and explores more ethical alternatives for data collection. This deep engagement with fair labor ethics is the central theme of the paper, not a peripheral section.
